values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; campsites can be booked for today. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. Campers arriving after 9 pm must call the park or risk losing the reservation. Two vehicles per site; extra cars pay a fee. Generators 9-11 am and 5-9 pm.
